name: carillon_at_dusk
promptTemplate: A carillon tower bathed in {{dusk_mood}} with {{gothic_arches}} stonework, carrying {{bell_size}}x bronze bells, mist density of {{mist_density}}, and sonic {{resonance}}.

ui.title: CARILLON DUSK +4
ui.tagline: Strike your bronze bell and cast rings into the sky

ring.hint: Strike to swing your bell and send out colored sonic rings

dusk_mood.hint: Cycle sky twilight palette and glow tint

gothic_arches.hint: Alter the stonework silhouette framing the bells

bell_size.hint: Scale the bronze bells and hanging ironwork

resonance.hint: Lengthen the life and radius of radiating sound waves

mist_density.hint: Haze obscuring the distant silhouettes below

listing.blurb: Bronze bells hang in a gothic belfry against twilight; everyone in the room strikes their bell to swing it and send resonant, luminous rings across the sky.
listing.prompt: A carillon tower at dusk with a row of bronze bells, one bell per person in the room; anyone can ring their bell, which swings and sends visible sound rings of their colour rippling out across the sky. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
